item.title: Week 10: Steelers at Bengals
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 8:20 PM ET | Line: CIN -3.5 · O/U 49.5 | Model CIN 58% vs. market 63% | On paper Cincinnati has the edge (Cincinnati ranks 1st in EPA per dropback, +0.33), while Pittsburgh's best counter is to lean on the run (Pittsburgh ranks 1st in EPA per designed run, +0.03). Under center, Joe Burrow ranks 1st of 31 in EPA per dropback and Aaron Rodgers ranks 27th; x-factor: Ja'Marr Chase gets 27% of Cincinnati's targets and 36% of its air yards, and Pittsburgh's pass defense ranks 17th. The model favors Cincinnati at 58%, mostly on starting QB (4.3 pts) and passing matchup (3.6 pts).
